models.name: Gemini 4 Carbon
models.note: #1 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (59). Strongest at long multi-step engineering and cyber defense. Only selected cyber defenders and partners can use it so far.

models.name: GPT-6.1 Terra
models.note: Mid-tier model tuned for computer use, visual reasoning, and everyday work. About half the price of GPT-6.1 Sol.

models.name: Gemini 4 Argon
models.note: Google's generally available Gemini 4. Takes text, image, video, audio, and PDF. Has computer use, search grounding, and low/medium/high thinking. Not on the free API tier.

models.name: Muse Wonder
models.note: Meta's frontier API model. Takes text, image, video, and audio. The bigger Muse Wonder Full (Intelligence Index 56) is only available in Muse Code ($50/mo).

models.name: Muse Spark Open
models.note: MoE with 816B total / 42B active parameters. Top US open-weight model on the Intelligence Index (39). License: commercial use only for companies under $20M revenue.

models.name: Claude Haiku 5.5
models.note: Cheapest Claude model. First Haiku with an adjustable effort setting.

models.name: Mistral Large 4
models.note: MoE with 1T total / ~52B active parameters, multimodal. Weights released Oct 29 under a modified MIT license (free in-house; hosting it as a service needs a commercial license). Quantized version needs about 4 B200/B300 GPUs.

models.name: GPT-6.1 Sol
models.note: OpenAI's main workhorse model for coding and professional work.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
models.note: About 30% faster than Sonnet 5 and up to 30% cheaper on most work. The balanced middle tier.

models.name: Claude Opus 5.5
models.note: Anthropic's flagship generally available model. Close to Mythos-tier results on most work at much lower cost.

models.name: GPT-6 Luna
models.note: OpenAI's cheapest tier, for high-volume simple tasks.

models.name: Grok 4.7
models.note: xAI's current flagship. Output priced below Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol.

models.name: DeepSeek V4.1-Flash
models.note: Smallest model in DeepSeek's V4 family, with native image understanding.

models.name: GPT-6 Astra
models.note: OpenAI's most capable model. Expensive, so save it for the hardest work.

models.name: Claude Fable 5.1
models.note: Mythos-tier model (above Opus) with extra safety measures for biology, cyber, and AI R&D. Same underlying model as Claude Mythos 5.1, which is restricted to select partners.

models.name: DeepSeek V4
models.note: 1.6T-parameter MoE. China's flagship open-weight model family this year.
